responsibility: Implements the RTL pass that combines and propagates stack-pointer adjustments across intervening stack references so that multiple frame or outgoing-argument allocations/deallocations become fewer, larger adjustments. Working block by block with DF simulation, it records stack-based MEM and SP references, recognizes SP-setting patterns including target-specific parallel forms, checks CFA/frame notes and validity ranges, rewrites affected addresses, and deletes or merges redundant adjustment instructions while preserving argument-size and CFA bookkeeping.
